versions.content: Bit 2 of the NetworkStateLIN shall contain the Tx Error state. This is an error that is related to the source frame that is reported in the same data item. The Tx Error state shall be set to 1 when the LIN controller detected an error during transmission of a LIN frame. Otherwise it shall be set to 0 .
